question: Yamini Krishnamurthy, an eminent _________ and Bharatanatyam dancer has been awarded the Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Kuchipudi ** 

 
 
• One of the eight principal Indian classical dances is Kuchipudi.
 
• It comes from the Andhra Pradesh state of India, specifically the village of Kuchipudi.
 
• Kuchipudi was created as a way to worship Krishna, a Hindu deity.
 
• Siddhendra Yogi, a gifted poet and visionary who belonged to the Vaishnava sect and had the ability to give some of his visions solid form, created the Kuchipudi style of Yakshagaana in the 17th century.
 
• Kuchipudi is renowned for its dynamic storytelling, dramatic characterization, outstanding, rapid dancing, and expressive eye movements.
 
• Tandava (the regal, masculine) and Lasya (lyrical graceful and feminine energy) are combined in this dance.
 
• Other famous dance forms of Andhra Pradesh include - Vilasini Natyam, Andhra Natyam, Bhamakalpam, Veeranatyam, Dappu, Tappeta Gullu, Lambadi, Dhimsa, Kolattam, Butta Bommalu.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kathakali **

 
 
• Kathakali is a classical dance form that originates from Kerala, a state in the southern part of India.
 
• It is distinguished by its vibrant costumes, elaborate makeup, and face masks that the performers wear.
 
• Kathakali translates to "Story-Play" and is known for its intricate storytelling, detailed gestures, and expressive eye movements.
 
• The dance form combines dance, music, drama, and literature into a composite art form, making it unique and complex.
 
• Themes of Kathakali are mostly taken from the Indian epics like Mahabharata, Ramayana, and other ancient scriptures.
 
• It is performed exclusively by men and involves rigorous physical training to master the art form.
 
• The music used in Kathakali is called Sopanam and is sung in the Malayalam language.
 
 
 
• **Kathak **
 
 
• Kathak is a North Indian dance which originated in the state of Uttar Pradesh. 
 
• The name Kathak comes from the word "katha" which means a story. Shambhu Maharaj is one of the famous Kathak dancer.
 
 
 
• ​Sattriya
 
• Satriya Nritya is the classical dance form of Assam which represents the Satriya culture, the basis of the religious and cultural fabric of Assam__.
 
 
• It is a dance-drama performance art with origins in the Krishna-centered Vaishnavism monasteries of Assam and attributed to the 15th-century Bhakti movement scholar and saint Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev.
 
• Dance historian Dr. Sunil Kothari has recently been bestowed with the Madhabdev Award by the Government of Assam for popularising Sattriya dance.
 
• Sattriya was given the status of classical dance in the year 2000 by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
